external.name: pi-lens
external.review: MIT. Self-contained Node; bundles @ast-grep/napi (native) + tree-sitter WASM + typescript. Auto-runs LSP/type/lint/structural + impact diagnostics on write/edit via hooks (no model tool required). Also registers optional LSP/AST agent tools — filter off in balanced to keep the visible surface minimal.

external.name: pi-lean-ctx
external.review: Apache-2.0. Routes bash/read/grep/find/ls output through lean-ctx compression + MCP session cache (~13 tokens on unchanged re-reads). Behavior-only; adds no visible model tools. REQUIRES the external `lean-ctx` CLI (leanctx.com) on PATH or configured in ~/.pi/agent/extensions/pi-lean-ctx/config.json — it is not bundled and not on npm, so without it the MCP bridge fails with spawn ENOENT and no compression happens. Left out of the lite profile for this reason (readseek covers navigation there); still referenced by the full-kit profiles for setups that install the binary.

external.name: pi-impact-analyzer
external.review: MIT. web-tree-sitter (WASM). Passive auto-indexing; answers 'if I change this symbol, what else breaks?'. Registers a query tool — keep dormant/filtered outside higher tiers.

external.name: pi-readseek
external.review: MIT. @jarkkojs/readseek (native) + xxhash-wasm. Hash-anchored read/edit/grep + structural code maps + AST search — a lean file-I/O primitive for navigating large repos cheaply. Registers replacement tools (manual).

external.name: pi-subagents
external.review: MIT. Optional power-up over the kit's own subagent/orchestrator layer: background jobs, TUI clarification questions, and an 'oracle' second-opinion agent. Deps: pi-tui, jiti, typebox (light). Does NOT auto-invoke; the kit's orchestrator provides the autonomy. Enable when you want background delegation or oracle critiques. Not in any profile's default include: both this and the kit's own vendor/subagent/index.ts register a tool literally named "subagent", so co-selecting them always collides - see docs/agent-orchestration.md.
